column9:
The hours spent is modeled as a fixed percentage of Total Dev Capacity, which can be configured.
(this reflects a decision to keep dev capacity stable)
The hours saved is modeled based on 3 factors:
1) Activity level of Copilot Usage
2) Lines of Code accepted from Copilot
3) Fixed productivity gain per dev-day of usage
(this reflects a decisio/expected impact of improving average usage levels)
column10:
Increases in average copilot activity, lines of code accepted, dev days of usage indicate that average AI benefits are increasing.
(when the modeled time savings based on these indicators agree, then we have increasing confidence in the time saved measurement)
